answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The walnut edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 199 clones produces a signature the atlas analysis flags immediately. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the echo settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
